title: MES: Motor Engagement Signal — open-source EEG pipeline for quantifying motor-cortical engagement in rehabilitation
description: MES (Motor Engagement Signal) is an open-source Python library and companion web application that converts clinical-style EEG recordings into a single calibrated 0-100 score reflecting motor-cortical engagement during movement or motor-imagery tasks. It combines mu/beta event-related desynchronization, a lateralization index, movement-related cortical potentials, and an ONNX ensemble of Riemannian and deep-learning classifiers, with scoring weights fit against dataset-provided task/rest labels to avoid circularity. MES targets stroke and spinal-cord-injury rehabilitation researchers who need interpretable, session-comparable endpoints rather than decoding accuracy alone, and supports low-channel ambulatory hardware such as OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy. Ships a documented CLI (mes score, mes validate, mes fit-weights), a validation harness, and an optional FastAPI + React dashboard.
